param("_image_billing") == nil ? tier("image_config_preview", 0) : (param("_image_billing.resolution") == "1K" ? tier("image_1k", param("_image_billing.input_count") * 10000 + param("_image_billing.output_count") * 100000) : (param("_image_billing.resolution") == "2K" ? tier("image_2k", param("_image_billing.input_count") * 20000 + param("_image_billing.output_count") * 200000) : (param("_image_billing.resolution") == "auto" ? tier("image_auto", max(param("_image_billing.input_count") * 10000 + param("_image_billing.output_count") * 100000, param("_image_billing.input_count") * 20000 + param("_image_billing.output_count") * 200000)) : tier("unsupported_image_parameters", -1))))
